Ocean view stateroom with large window and Princess's signature comfort. MedallionClass enables seamless service throughout.

inclusions: All meals in main dining rooms and World Fresh Marketplace

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 91 (Smith Cove Terminal). Royal Princess departs on a 7-night Alaska voyage featuring the dramatic Tracy Arm Fjord.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: Alaska's capital — gateway to Mendenhall Glacier, whale watching in Auke Bay, and the famous Red Dog Saloon. Allow time for the Mount Roberts Tramway.
portsOfCall.name: Juneau, AK

portsOfCall.description: A perfectly preserved National Historic Landmark. Ride the White Pass & Yukon Route Railway through breathtaking alpine scenery to the Canadian border.
portsOfCall.name: Skagway, AK

portsOfCall.description: Scenic cruising through the dramatic Tracy Arm Fjord — a narrow channel carved by glaciers with sheer granite walls rising thousands of feet. The Sawyer Glaciers await at the fjord's end.
portsOfCall.name: Tracy Arm Fjord

portsOfCall.description: Famous for totem poles, Creek Street's historic cannery boardwalk, and world-class sport fishing. Sample fresh Dungeness crab straight from the docks.
portsOfCall.name: Ketchikan, AK

portsOfCall.description: An enchanting evening arrival in British Columbia's capital. Explore the Inner Harbour, catch a horse-drawn carriage tour, or visit the Royal BC Museum.
portsOfCall.name: Victoria, BC

reviewSnippet: Princess has decades of Alaska experience, and this itinerary includes Tracy Arm Fjord's narrow granite walls and glaciers — a balanced choice for couples and families alike.

overrides.note: 10-night Alaska one-way Seattle → Vancouver with Glacier Bay (cruisetimetables.com).

portsOfCall.description: Embarkation at Pier 91 for a 10-night Alaska voyage ending in Vancouver.
portsOfCall.name: Seattle, WA

portsOfCall.description: A full day of ranger-narrated scenic cruising.
portsOfCall.name: Glacier Bay National Park

portsOfCall.description: Sailing south through the Inside Passage.
portsOfCall.name: At Sea – Inside Passage
